name: Continue
about: Carry on: the server has the headers and is waiting for the body.

name: Switching Protocols
about: Changing to the protocol you asked for, usually WebSockets.

name: OK
about: Everything worked.

name: Created
about: Done, and something new now exists.

name: Accepted
about: Got it. It will happen later, in a queue somewhere.

name: No Content
about: Done, and there is nothing to send back.

name: Partial Content
about: Here is the piece you asked for, as when a video skips ahead.

name: Moved Permanently
about: It lives somewhere else now. Update your links.

name: Found
about: It is somewhere else, for now.

name: Not Modified
about: Your cached copy is still good. Nothing to download.

name: Temporary Redirect
about: Somewhere else for now; send the same request there.

name: Permanent Redirect
about: Somewhere else for good; send the same request there.

name: Bad Request
about: The server could not make sense of what was sent.

name: Unauthorized
about: Who are you? Log in first.

name: Forbidden
about: I know who you are. Still no.

name: Not Found
about: Nothing here. On this site, that means a kernel panic.

name: Method Not Allowed
about: Right address, wrong verb: a POST where only GET goes.

name: Request Timeout
about: The server got tired of waiting for you.

name: Conflict
about: It clashes with what is there now, like two people saving the same node.

name: Gone
about: It was here, and it is not coming back.

name: Content Too Large
about: That upload is too big. Time to look at upload_max_filesize.

name: Unsupported Media Type
about: The server does not take that kind of file.

name: I'm a teapot
about: Asked to brew coffee, a teapot refuses. An April Fools' joke from 1998 that never left.

name: Page Expired
about: Not a standard code: it is Laravel's own. The CSRF token ran out; reload the form and try again.

name: Unprocessable Content
about: Understood, but the data does not validate. Laravel's favourite answer to a bad form.

name: Too Early
about: Too soon to risk replaying this request.

name: Too Many Requests
about: Slow down. You hit the rate limit.

name: Unavailable For Legal Reasons
about: Blocked by law. The number is a nod to Fahrenheit 451.

name: Internal Server Error
about: Something broke on the server. Check the logs.

name: Bad Gateway
about: The server in front got a bad answer from the one behind it.

name: Service Unavailable
about: Down for maintenance, or overloaded. What Drupal's maintenance mode sends.

name: Gateway Timeout
about: The server behind took too long to answer.
